# OneEighty

> > OneEighty provides substance abuse and mental health services in Wooster and Holmes County, Ohio.

OneEighty is a community-based organization offering certified mental health and substance abuse treatment programs. The organization serves Wayne and Holmes Counties through professional staff and community fundraising events.

## Key Topics

- Substance abuse treatment
- Mental health services
- Wooster, Ohio
- Holmes County
- Bobbi Douglas (Executive Director)
- Community fundraising
- Golf scramble events
- Staff professionals
- Charitable giving
- Recovery programs
- Wayne County services
- Thrift shop fundraising
- Mental health professionals
- Community support

## About OneEighty

- [Substance Abuse and Mental Health Staff](https://www.one-eighty.org/about/staff): Staff directory of certified mental health and substance abuse professionals

## Fundraising Events

- [Changing Direction Golf Scramble on September 21st](https://www.one-eighty.org/events/changing-direction-golf-scramble-on-september-21st): Annual golf fundraiser at Wooster Country Club with contests and lunch
- [Save and Serve Thrift Shop in Millersburg](https://www.one-eighty.org/events/save-and-serve-shop-to-donate-event-on-march-30th): Thrift shop fundraiser in Millersburg supporting Holmes County programs

## Community News & Recognition

- [Bobbi's Retirement/Recognition](https://www.one-eighty.org/events/bobbis-retirement-recognition): Executive Director Bobbi Douglas retirement event at Freelander Chalet
